get.description: The tenant's usage per license: plan, current period and, per licensed entitlement, the allowance, consumption, trend, projection and limit behaviour; plus meters consumed without a licensed entitlement.
Every registered usage meter: key, unit, aggregation, licensed entitlement, source and whether it is rated.

get.summary: List every tenant's usage against its limits (root admin)
get.description: Root-admin, server-paged list of tenants holding licenses: the worst meter status, the highest percent used, meters near or over, and active hard stops. Usage and limits only; no personal data.
Root-admin read of one tenant's usage detail. Refused for anyone who is not a root admin of the instance root tenant.

get.summary: Get a tenant's usage limit overrides (root admin)
get.description: Root-admin audit read of one tenant's usage limit overrides, active and past: the license and meter, the grant and pool before and after, the hard stop before and after, the actor, reason and expiry.

post.summary: Override a tenant's usage limit (root admin)
post.description: Root-admin, audited change to ONE license's grant of one meter: set or extend the allowance, or reset a reached hard stop for the current period. Requires ExpectedRevision (the grant's Revision): 400 when missing, 409 when stale. Changes enforcement limits only. Returns the new override's id.
